shards.title: The Howling Eclipse
shards.lore: Where the Cosmic Pulse runs deepest, the birthplace of the next great surge.

shards.title: The permanent wave
shards.lore: The permanent EMP wave woke this Frontier Shard. Bolt sprints toward it, lightning in his wake.

shards.title: No howl lost
shards.lore: No howl of significance shall be lost to time. The Eclipse Gate keeps this one.

shards.title: Not a vehicle
shards.lore: The wreck is a memory, not a ship to fly. The Lightning Core in Bolt's chest carries the sprint.

shards.title: Whispering arch
shards.lore: Sealed in the Hall of Whispering Archives, the old arch still stands and still remembers.

shards.title: How it felt
shards.lore: An Echo Shard carries not only what happened, but how it felt.
